nom: Hyaluronic Acid Serum for Skin 100% Pure Anti Aging Intense Hydration Moisture Non greasy Paraben free

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one who calls her skin 'very oily,' report the serum helped control excess oil and left skin balanced rather than greasy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report relief from flakiness and tightness with regular use, though one with dry skin around the mouth and nose says her skin feels tight again within minutes of application unless she layers a moisturizer on top.
segments.combination: Reviewers with an oily t-zone and drier cheeks, and one who describes her skin as 'oily and mix,' report the serum hydrates without adding shine to the oily areas.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several with sensitive, rosacea-prone, or allergy-prone skin report no irritation and real hydration benefit, while a smaller number report burning, red marks, or an allergic-type reaction, in one case attributed to the benzyl alcohol in the formula.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to 70s report plumper skin and softened fine lines and wrinkles with regular use, several describing it as part of a broader anti-aging routine alongside retinol or moisturizer.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers using the serum against fine lines and wrinkles report visibly plumper, smoother skin and softened lines within weeks, especially around the eyes and mouth; one notes the improvement plateaued after about two weeks and did not progress further.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report a marked increase in hydration and softer, plumper skin, including overnight relief for chronic dry, chapped lips; a couple of reviewers say the effect is short-lived and skin can feel tight again within minutes unless a moisturizer is applied on top.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report a more even skin tone and reduced redness over time, including one with rosacea who says it helped more than other products she tried; a few describe an initial 'purging' period with temporary redness or small breakouts before their skin improved.
concerns.barrier: A minority of reviewers report the serum burned or irritated their skin, with symptoms including redness, itching, and a burning sensation, in one case linked to the benzyl alcohol in the formula; most other reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report no irritation at all.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of dark spots, sun spots, hyperpigmentation, and dark under-eye circles with regular use over several weeks to months.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report fewer breakouts and reduced closed comedones or scarring over time, and a few describe an initial purge of small breakouts before their skin cleared; one reviewer reports the opposite, an immediate breakout within her first week of use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum helped balance oil production, with one saying her skin stopped overproducing oil once it was properly hydrated.

aspects.libelle: Glass bottle prone to breaking or leaking
Feels tight if applied on dry skin

extraits.titre: Be careful guys, for people who has sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I have never had the heart of writing a bad review. But this things burns my face. I just want others people to be aware of it, otherwise they might regrets or for the worse case might destroy their face. While I was putting the serum in my eyebrow, I started to see red mark in my face and also feel the heat. I just realized that this is where the serums dropping down from my eyebrow where I put the serums. I ran to wash my face and take shower right away. This picture was taking 25mins after I take shower and wash my face many times. I still feel the heat. It is a life lesson for me that I will never use acid. Congrats for those whom has use this serum and works wonders for them.

extraits.titre: <Dry skin> skin gets tight after couple of minutes
extraits.texte: I have dry skin epecially around my mouth and nose and so I gave it a try. After using facial cleanser, I use 2 drops as instructed in the morning and night. It absorbs in 2 min into my skin which feels good. But after that 2 minutes skin feels tight which I wanted to fet rid of and didnt work. So I have to use a moisturizing creem after every use. It somehow works that way but if I have to rely on cream then whats the point of using it. So if you have a dry skin like me, I dont think it is the best choice but you can give it a try with good moisturizing cream.

extraits.titre: I just received my 4th bottle of liquid gold
extraits.texte: I just received my 4th bottle of liquid gold (aka Hyaluronic Acid Serum) and have been using it for 3 months now. For what seems like forever, I have struggled with dark eye circles, discoloration from freckles/sun damage, and dry skin manifesting in the form of scaly, deep pores. At 26 years old, you shouldn’t have to deal with these issues… fast forward 3 months, I could NOT imagine my daily beauty routine without the serum. Two drops in the morning + two drops at night is all that is needed for my skin to brighten, hydrate, and dark spots/circles fade. Also, it helps my makeup stay fresh and dewy all day--without getting a greasy, shiny face. The perfect size for my cosmetic bag (I travel a lot!) and the bottle comes full to the top so that you get your money's worth--especially since a little bit goes a long way. The Cosmedica customer service team is amazing. They go out of their way to deliver great service. In a recent experience, I received a damaged product from Amazon delivery and a team member followed up with me afterwards and sent me a brand-new bottle. The attached photos are after just 10 days of directed use. The photos were taking at the same time of day (morning) in the same room/lighting (bathroom). You can see how my skin is brighter, sun spots have started to fade, dark eye circles/bags/lines have almost disappeared, and the texture of my skin just looks smoother and more hydrated.

extraits.titre: Definitely a new staple in my skincare routine!
extraits.texte: I’ve been using this product for about two weeks now, along with the Caudelie toner (before serum) and an overnight moisturizer (after serum). The first day I didn’t notice anything other than smoothness, but I really notice now. I’ve even had others recognize the difference in my skin. I apply at night and sometimes in mornings if my skin is still dry. It has not only helped clear acne spots, but it’s helped a lot of redness/uneven skin tones, given me clearer skin, and also made my face super smooth! *I have rosacea and sensitive/dry skin and this product didn’t irritate my face. I actually found it has benefited my rosacea more so than any other products I’ve tried.

extraits.titre: Excellent Product! My holy grail to my skin care routine!
extraits.texte: When it comes to new products that I use on my face I like to do my research. I read reviews, compare products and of course see what is the best bang for my buck. I have VERY oily skin. I was looking for a product to moisturize/hydrate my skin and help control my oil. I use a dermaroller and needed a product to use with it. THIS IS IT! I found my holy grail to my routine. After dermarolling I apply this Serum and then a light moisturizer. My skin hasn’t been this clear and bright in years. I’m so happy I found this product! Also it has an actual dropper which helps you not waste product.

extraits.titre: AMAZING for oily, dry, and combination skin!
extraits.texte: I ordered a 4 ounce around September and there is definitely a difference in my skin. My skin used to be REALLY OILY and I was told that means your skin is really dry and trying to overcompensate. So I tried this and it worked amazing. I’m only 20 years old so it may not seem like this does a lot but my skin has not been oily since I started using this. AND my skin actually looks and feels really supple and moisturized. I use it everyday and night and when I do a sheet mask I use this before it. I recently bought the 8 ounce size and it’s worth it!

BUUUUY THIS! So I’m 22 with acne prone skin. I have oily skin and not many wrinkles yet. I started use this and after a couple days started seeing results my skin is so glows and hydrated! I always stay away from any makeup look that’s “dewy” because I look like an oil spill within a couple hours but THIS has changed my life. I use it every morning and every night before moisturizer. Also the only place I have defined wrinkles is on my neck from tanning and a teen and this is slowly blurring them I’m so happy BUY IT.
